name: realtime-sse
title: Realtime (SSE)
description: Live resource changes over Server-Sent Events, filtered per subscriber with the same policies, scopes and field visibility as the REST API.
docs:
1. POST /api/realtime/ticket (signed in) -> { data: { ticket } }   (single use, 60 seconds)
2. new EventSource('/api/realtime/stream?resources=post,product&ticket=' + ticket)
Events: post.created / post.updated (serialized record) and post.deleted ({ id }).
Anonymous visitors can subscribe without a ticket and only receive what 'public' policies allow.
Single instance: events are in-process. For several instances, publish events through MongoDB change streams (see block docs).
